text:
**My pick: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W), $29.99 at Newegg.** [Buy it here](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3).

**Why it fits a laptop and phone**
- Anker's spec sheet lists 65W from either USB-C port when only one device is connected, plus a USB-A port ([Anker spec page](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY)).
- With a laptop and phone on the two USB-C ports, it splits 45W + 20W. That's enough for a MacBook Air or a thin Windows ultrabook, plus a fast phone charge.
- It's about the size of an AirPods Pro case and has an 18-month warranty ([Newegg listing](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3)).
- It has PPS, so it should also work for Samsung fast charging. One of the review sites says it doesn't, but Anker's own listing includes PPS.
- Reviewers rank this Anker class first for 65W multiport chargers ([Laptopbee](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-65w-usb-c-chargers/)). Those sites' testing claims are their own and I can't verify them.

**Caveats**
- The 65W is shared. With all three ports in use, the top USB-C port drops to 40W, and the other two ports get 12W each.
- No cable is included. Buy a USB-C cable rated for 60W or more for your laptop.
- A laptop that needs a full 65W will charge slower while your phone is also plugged in.

**Alternatives**
- **Baseus Enercore 67W (CJ11), about $29.99:** Tom's Hardware named it the best 65W-range charger. It held full output throughout testing, ran the coolest of the group, and has a built-in retractable USB-C cable plus two more USB-C ports ([Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers)). The article doesn't give a direct purchase link, so check Amazon or Best Buy.
- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W:** Smart Gadget Kit's top pick. It weighs 113g, has three ports, and ships with US, UK and EU plug heads. It's a good choice if you travel internationally ([Smart Gadget Kit](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/)). The page lists a "Check latest price" button but I don't have a direct product URL.
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W 2-pack, $49.99:** Gives you one charger for home and one for your bag. It has PD 3.0 and PPS, and the same 45W + 20W split ([Dealectric, affiliate link](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u)). No discount code worked when tested on 2026-10-24.

If you have a 14" or 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop, 65W will be tight. Consider a 100W charger instead.
